test a robust weighted combination using softmax_neg_error to see if a different weighting scheme improves over simple mean, given unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
The series has unstable ranking (tau -0.17) and strong trend/seasonality; a robust Damped BMA on a small, diverse pool may improve robustness.
test a robust median combination on full pool
test a weighted combination on the stable pool4 using inverse_error to see if a focused weighted set beats mean.
test a per‑horizon weighted combo on the stable pool4 to see if softmax weighting improves over inverse_error.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool using the best_per_horizon handle w6 to see if horizon‑specific picks improve over global weighting.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable; a robust mean over a stable, correlated‑group subset (pool4) may outperform full‑pool mean.
Ranking is unstable, so a robust weighted combo on the full pool may beat mean; test inverse_error weights on all models.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool using the top‑k‑mean‑per‑horizon handle (w8) to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over the global weighted mean.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9423 and seasonal strength 0.989; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.17); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.541.
